notes: Proof-only. Algebra.isMulCommutative_adjoin now takes `s.Pairwise Commute`, so the lambda takes the extra `a ≠ b` argument and uses `show a * b = b * a` to keep the existing case proofs. TFAE.out is now 1-indexed, so `.out 0 3` becomes `.out 1 4` and `.out 0 2` becomes `.out 1 3`; these are the same equivalences.
